target: Commault–Mocanu2003 Conjecture1: determine the minimum PH order of the all-pole three-pole family, one dominant real pole and one complex conjugate pair, for every real a>c>0 and b>0.

book_link.scope: Published2003 conjecture is one precisely stated special family of the broad book question; no general PH minimal-realization solution implied.

exact_statement.parameters: a>c>0,b>0, all real; arbitrary finite PH representations, no topology ansatz in the target.
exact_statement.minimum: n*=min{integer n>=3: b<=(a-c)*cot(pi/n)} = ceil(pi/arctan((a-c)/b)). Upper band endpoints included; lower endpoint uses the smaller n.
exact_statement.PH: alpha is a nonnegative row vector summing to1; T real n×n Metzler, T*1<=0 and Hurwitz; F(s)=alpha*(sI-T)^(-1)*(-T*1).
exact_statement.negative: A rigorous explicit parameter counterexample must prove n* impossible among ALL PH realizations, not only cycles or numerical optimization.

primary.paper: Commault–Mocanu, International Journal of Control76(6),566–580(2003), DOI10.1080/0020717031000114986
primary.conjecture: PDFpage13,printed577,Conjecture1: There exists a representation of order n_min for such a distribution.
primary.lower_bound: Import Theorem6 sector bound, with explicit justification that it applies after trimming unreachable PH states and identifying the dominant pole; do not assume unobserved state eigenvalues equal transfer poles.

baseline.upper: Paper reports n*+1 possible from Mocanu1999 thesis; thesis unread.
baseline.headroom: All-n sharp order n* is the precise conjectured improvement; n4 alone or finite numerical instances are partial, not gate.

screen.result: No resolution located in bounded screen; folklore/access gaps; not novelty.

previous.status: GATE MET with both finite objects; imported written infinite family, no Lean proof.

initial_representation: Untrusted positive realization using a Metzler n-cycle, three adjustable diagonal angles and n-3 repeated diagonals; cancel unused poles with nonnegative exit Taylor coefficients, then positive diagonal scaling to a PH generator. This is a search/proof choice, not a target restriction.
first_obligation: Freeze lane README before substantive experiments; read original book images, paper equations/conjecture/Theorems4/6/14; derive all-n construction or falsify its first exact n4/n5 instances. Priority screen in parallel may stop the target if a prior equivalent is found.
controls: Known n3 regime and spectral equality beta=cot(pi/n); exact polynomial/transfer identity; rate/normalization/Hurwitz checks; negative exits or wrong transfer from a perturbation; above-threshold parameters cannot be realized at the same n (check against sector theorem, not a failed optimizer). Interval root/positivity checks are finite smoke, never the all-real proof.
acceptance: Complete all-n written proof or exact unrestricted counterexample; parent independent symbolic/interval smoke plus mathematical derivation; both CLI-family hostile reviews; exact match to source definitions/quantifiers; post-result primary/grey-literature and equivalent-software priority check. No all-n conclusion from finite numerical tables.
